Committee: Finance and Taxation Education
Sponsor: Beasley
Analyst: Daniel Davenport
Date: 03/15/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 185 as introduced appropriates $12,257,156 from the Education Trust Fund to Tuskegee University for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2022. In addition, this act requires at least $2,000,000 of the total appropriation to be expended for the agricultural research and extension state match.
Arthur Orr, Chairperson
Finance and Taxation Education

FISCAL NOTE
